name: exact_title_no_authors
why: Both sides bare: an identical title is a match on the title score alone.

name: exact_title_same_author
why: Identical title and author - the author boost is capped at 100.

name: author_initials_and_suffix_punctuation
why: 'L.E. Modesitt Jr.' and 'L. E. Modesitt, Jr.' are the same person once periods and commas are stripped, so the author gate passes and boosts.

name: author_surname_first
why: 'Butcher, Jim' vs 'Jim Butcher' - token_set_ratio after comma stripping.

name: leading_article_stripped_from_title
why: 'The Hobbit' and 'Hobbit' normalize to the same string.

name: same_series_same_index
why: Series names agree and both indexes are 2 - nothing rejects it.

name: series_name_with_leading_article
why: 'The Dresden Files' vs 'Dresden Files' compare equal after article strip.

name: only_one_side_has_series
why: Missing series metadata on one side is not evidence of a different book.

name: series_index_1_and_1_5_truncate_equal
why: PINS A QUESTIONABLE RULE (issue #253): int() truncation makes the novella 1.5 the same book as 1, so a #1.5 audiobook can be paired with the #1 ebook.

name: title_near_miss_matches_when_one_side_has_no_author
why: PINS A QUESTIONABLE RULE (issue #253): with no author on the audiobook the author gate is skipped entirely and a title score alone pairs two different books.

name: hash_exclusion_blocks_the_pair
why: A manual unpair recorded the audiobook's hash on the ebook - never re-pair.

name: hash_exclusion_recorded_on_the_audiobook_side
why: The exclusion is symmetric: either side's list blocks the pair.

name: exclusion_is_not_honoured_without_a_file_hash
why: PINS A QUESTIONABLE RULE (issue #253): the exclusion is keyed by file hash, so a hash-less row (legacy) is re-paired on the next scan despite the unpair.

name: different_authors_reject_a_perfect_title
why: Same title, different people - the author gate rejects before scoring.

name: same_series_different_index
why: Book 2 is not book 5, however similar the titles.

name: different_series_same_title
why: Series names below 85 are different series regardless of the title score.

name: title_near_miss_below_threshold
why: Two unrelated titles by the same author score under the threshold.

name: empty_titles_on_both_sides
why: Degenerate metadata must not become a 100-scoring pair.
